settings.heading: Hi! I'm Melanie.
settings.text:
I'm a writer and farm-loving mom who lives on a little patch of land with my family and animals (including a flock of spirited chickens!). Inspired by my son and everyday moments in the countryside, I wrote Clover, the Brave Chicken to celebrate courage, curiosity, and the quiet strength that lives inside every child.

I'm a big believer in muddy boots, bedtime stories, and raising kids to be both kind and brave. Thank you for supporting my dreams with Clover!

settings.heading: The critics are clucking about Clover

settings.quote: “Clover’s worries will feel familiar to many readers, and through her gentle moments of uncertainty and self-discovery, her quiet optimism and determination make her an endearing character to follow. […] A charming farmyard story about finding the courage to embrace who you are.”

“Set amidst the familiar sights and sounds of an idyllic farmyard, this story teaches readers about the importance of being true to oneself and recognizing one’s own strengths. […] Perfect for shared reading, especially aloud, this uplifting story will help young readers reflect on their own unique gifts.”
